note: Ours, read by make-events.js (docs/notes/events.md). evStage = evStageBase + r, stage = stageBase + n (server/event_ids.json, append-only). serve: census ids (the April 2019 pilot, Events Part 1) and types (GEM, Part 2) that are built, the rest is notSelected (an old onlyCensusIds list still works; no serve and no list builds every record). reasonText: the catalogue text of every reason a record or quest is not built. labelPhrases: the reconstruction notes of the event quest records -> label id; reconstructedWhy: the text of every label (shown in the Event Catalog, declared in the Notices). eventType: the fallback when the donor rows give none (make-events uses the donor value, never 2 = the raid mode with the Raid Boards button). catalogEvStage: the Event Catalog banner (evStageBase + 0, never a record: records are numbered from 1), holding catalogStage (the Training Grounds of the Special Catalog), Details -> catalogUrl.

reasonText.shared: This notice shares its quests with another row of the catalogue: they are built once, under the other row.
reasonText.board: In the original this event had no quests of its own: it was played on the event boards, which come with a later update.
reasonText.coin: In the original this event had no quests of its own: it paid Event Coins, which come with the event boards in a later update.
reasonText.undated: The original start date of this event is not known, so it cannot be placed in the calendar and is not listed.
reasonText.wikiEmpty: The khuxwiki page of this quest gives no map and no enemy we can identify, so it cannot be rebuilt yet.
reasonText.rewardItemMissing: A reward of this quest (a medal or a material) does not exist in our game data yet, so the quest is not served.
reasonText.notSelected: Not part of the events served so far.

reconstructedWhy.donorKept: The quest keeps the values of the later game data; the khuxwiki page describes an earlier run of the same quest (2018), so it was not used for this one.
reconstructedWhy.wikiLowConfidence: One value of this quest comes from the khuxwiki page and could not be confirmed by a second source.
reconstructedWhy.mapIncomplete: The map file of this quest is incomplete in the data we have: the missing parts are reported, never invented.
reconstructedWhy.noWikiPage: No khuxwiki page exists for this quest: its values come from the later game data only, without a second source.
reconstructedWhy.wikiQuest: Quest rebuilt from the khuxwiki page: no master row of the original is known
reconstructedWhy.wholeDay: In the original this event was open for a short window (minutes to hours); here it is open for its whole original day.
reconstructedWhy.dramaOff: The original scenes before or after this quest are not shown yet.
reconstructedWhy.eventCoins: Event Coin rewards are not paid yet: they come with the event boards in a later update.
reconstructedWhy.wwEnemy: Map enemy changed to the WW enemy (khuxwiki): the Japanese map file of this quest places a different enemy than the worldwide quest had, so that one enemy was replaced by the worldwide one (same place, count, level and drops).

mapEnemySwapsNote: User ruling 06-11: where the JP map file names another enemy than the WW quest (khuxwiki), the WW enemy. Keyed by map key (the stage row's stageBinId); from/to are enemy ids of our master (story rows). Read by make-events.js (quest enemies, label wwEnemy) and recon/tools/import_event_stages.py (patches the same ids in the copied map file).

keptTabNote: Where the KEPT EVENT tab of make_special_banners.py --section event goes on a card: left (default) or right, by evStageId (the left one hides the art of some originals).
